name: Zenofex
biography: Zenofex (@zenofex) is a researcher with Exploitee.rs. Amir founded "Exploitee.rs" which is a public research group and has released exploits for over 45 devices including the Amazon FireTV, Roku Media Player and the Google Chromecast. Amir is also a member of Austin Hackers and has spoken at a number of security conferences including DEF CON, B-Sides Austin, and InfoSec Southwest. @exploiteers @zenofex
